notes.title: New update 0.6.9 Available!
notes.content:
Hello friends! The new update has arrived.

So what's new.

In the mines added a new boss! One of the three cubic mechanisms, originally such mechanisms were created to help people but after a long time of being in an abandoned state, the program of these mechanisms begins to fail and it is better to bypass such mechanisms, if you can, of course. The second mechanism is being worked on, it will be added in the next update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38220643/4a77516f132e67239218a70f828fef4baa79979c.png[/img]

Remade some animations in particular Running, Attack with main weapon, Attack with sub-weapon. Also reduced pauses between attacks and chopping enemies became a little more comfortable.

Some elements of the rooms in the location of the toad forest redrawn and changed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38220643/c96970af3743b3b7e50e991687108a57ccc2d414.png[/img]

Added activities in the location toad forest see screenshots, they are not yet active and is being finalized in the future it will be optional actions to get secret things. (I hope you understand what I just said.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38220643/db110600b259cbfcd06b26625ce47735066aaee2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38220643/9e6c8a95f9ca9cfdfdd2351c432f3f148ee7e166.png[/img]

Added hotkeys for quick change of sub-weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38220643/11c151018f8337549623709f2635e7ffad4e6889.png[/img]

Changed the menu of the ship, it added a video overview of abilities in the future menu will be redesigned will be more abilities. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38220643/864e95a80ffb8870314433b727ce48fbde0f4c2b.png[/img]

Also fixed some bugs and made color correction of some scenes.
.
This is all for now at the moment in conclusion I want to inform you that with the next update will be published roadmap of the game that you would understand what will be added in the near future. 
Thank you all and good luck !!!

notes.title: Submarine available !!!
notes.content:
Hi all! The new update has arrived!
What's new.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38220643/96df8313fada296b3ec5d9a5f368e8cfd425c7b1.gif[/img]
- Added the ability to swim underwater in a mini submarine. To use a submarine, you first need to create a device to call the submarine in the spaceship menu. Then use this device near water.
- New rooms to explore underwater and new things to collect in the thorny river are also available.

- Increased character gravity.
- Many enemies have slight changes in behavior and sprites.
- Larger gems (local currency) have been added to the game, which add 5 and 20 points.
You can get them -
- Knocking out of the Big Crystal
- Receive as a boss reward
- Obtained from normal enemies if a special chip is equipped.

- Some bugs have also been fixed.

We are currently working on a new location, which according to the plan will be available in July.
Thanks everyone.

notes.title: Added a new location !!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Available update - 0.5.7
- Added a new location - "Flower Cave" to get to it through the location "Thorn River" when the ability "Double Jump" is available.
- New sub-weapon - Electrosphere.
- New chip.
- In the location "Thorn River" changed music.
- Fixed bug (Sometimes double jump was higher than it should be).
- Fixed bug (Sometimes when colliding with the ground the character would freeze and could not jump).
- Minor fixes and tweaks.

- The next update is scheduled for April or May, it will have access to the bathyscaphe to swim underwater. 
Good luck to everyone !

notes.title: Attention, major game update!!!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! .
First of all, our team apologizes to you for not having information about the game for so long, we will improve!

There were several reasons why the game's development was slow.
The first reason is that until the summer of 2022 there were problems with financing, the development of the game was very slow, mainly by one person.
The second reason - When the funding problem was solved and our team grew, it was decided to significantly remake the game because the quality of the game at that time was low and success would be difficult to achieve in the future.

Fortunately, all of the above problems are behind us, and now the game is being developed at full speed, the game looks and feels much better.

We present  game update 0.5.0.0

What's new! (Almost all)
- World - In the old version of the game there was a world map through which you could get to locations, and all locations were isolated from each other.
In the new version, the world is explored like in classic Metroidvania games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38220643/dcb775d798a1ef0fb0219766115eff58688cf620.png[/img]

- Art - Almost all sprites (80%) were redrawn, including the main character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38220643/a4d65ede6feb829ef1af11a6b27da73d398464a3.png[/img]

- Enemies - Many enemies have been reworked and new ones have been added.
- Bosses - Completely redesigned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38220643/53295a50146f9165f77bff5bbd7e996d4479e5fd.png[/img]

- Music - Almost everything is new, but some tracks in alpha versions will change in the future.
- Added an underground train system for fast travel around the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38220643/1dddad8d39349296cd9f3a7e1982fdeb6370fbf7.png[/img]

- The main character has changed her appearance, attacks, animations. The second character (COOP) is not working yet and will be available in other updates.

- A laboratory has been added to the spaceship in the initial location where you can obtain new character abilities

- Level design has been greatly changed.
- Added dialogues.
- Added languages - Japanese, Chinese, and Russian. The translation may contain errors, a professional translation will be available closer to the game's release, and other languages will also be available later.
- The game's store page has been updated to include new screenshots and gameplay videos.
- and many more small changes.

Unfortunately the game is still in early access. The approximate release date for version 1.0 is the end of 2024, the exact date will be announced later.

We will release updates regularly approximately every 1-2 months. The next update which will add a new location is scheduled for January.
Update 0.5.0.0 is already available on Steam, you can download and test it.

Once again we apologize for the delay!!! We will do everything possible to get the game out of early access as quickly as possible!!! Thanks to everyone who buys the game in early access, it helps us a lot! And I get to work. See you soon everyone.

notes.title: Exploaris: vermis story will be available in a few hours!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38220643/3ef331ec3dfbc5767fceb7ea24ba377c90614999.png[/img]

Hey guys, we have good news for you, there are only a few hours left before the game launches on Steam.
before you buy the game we want to draw your attention to some things!

- at the moment, any gamepads and keyboard are supported, but you will not be able to configure the buttons now, it will be available later.

- the story is currently in development, will also be available later.

- updates for the game will be released every 1-2 months.

We're confident that early access will help us make the game better and finish faster.
Many thanks to everyone who will support us.
